name: Mewtwo
abilityDesc: If this Pokémon is the target of a foe's move, that move loses one additional PP.

pool.name: Aerial Ace
pool.desc: A slashing aerial dash that strikes from the side. Can't be dodged.

pool.name: Amnesia
pool.desc: Raises Sp. Def by 2. Works twice per stay on the field.

pool.name: Ancient Power
pool.desc: Circling rocks are hurled at the target. 10% chance to raise all the user's stats by 1.

pool.name: Aura Sphere
pool.desc: Fires a ball of aura energy at the target. Can't be dodged.

pool.name: Blizzard
pool.desc: Engulfs the target in a raging snowstorm of rapid hits. 10% chance to freeze.

pool.name: Body Slam
pool.desc: Leaps and slams its full weight onto the target. 30% chance to paralyze.

pool.name: Earth Power
pool.desc: The ground under the target cracks and erupts. 10% chance to lower its Sp. Def. Move away to avoid it.

pool.name: Earthquake
pool.desc: A shockwave rolls out across the ground. Pokémon in the air avoid it; hits a digging Pokémon for double damage.

pool.name: Fire Blast
pool.desc: Hurls a huge fireball that explodes on impact. 15% chance to burn.

pool.name: Flamethrower
pool.desc: Sprays a stream of fire over the target. Each hit has a small chance to burn.

pool.name: Future Sight
pool.desc: Foresees an attack: about 4 seconds later, a psychic blast strikes whoever is on the target's side.

pool.name: Giga Impact
pool.desc: An all-out charging slam. Leaves the user unable to act for 2 seconds afterwards.

pool.name: Hyper Beam
pool.desc: Charges up, then fires a huge beam. Leaves the user unable to act for a moment afterwards.

pool.name: Ice Beam
pool.desc: Fires a freezing beam at the target. 15% chance to freeze.

pool.name: Psychic
pool.desc: Either lifts the target in a psychic grip, squeezes it and slams it down, or tears three or four boulders out of the ground and hurls them (now and then one is knocked away).

pool.name: Psycho Cut
pool.desc: Conjures psychic blades and flings them one by one, the last the biggest. High critical-hit ratio.

pool.name: Psystrike
pool.desc: Rises with a halo of psychic orbs that crash into the target one after another, then close into one crushing orb round it. Can't be dodged.

pool.name: Recover
pool.desc: Restores 30% of max HP. Works twice a battle (all its healing moves together).

pool.name: Shadow Ball
pool.desc: Hurls a shadowy orb, or a cluster of smaller orbs, at the target.

pool.name: Solar Beam
pool.desc: Soaks up sunlight for a moment, then fires a sweeping beam.

pool.name: Stone Edge
pool.desc: Sharp stone spires burst up under the target. High critical-hit ratio.

pool.name: Swift
pool.desc: Fires a burst of star-shaped rays. Can't be dodged.

pool.name: Thunder
pool.desc: A huge bolt from a storm cloud above the target. 30% chance to paralyze. Sometimes misses.

pool.name: Thunderbolt
pool.desc: A crackling stream of bolts ending in a big strike. Each zap may paralyze (4-10%).
